integrity: Proof uses explicit Johnson harmonic recurrence, a strict monotonicity inequality, exact rational interval certificates, and a classical negative-type theorem. Numerical eigensolver tests are checks, not infinite proofs.
limitations: Only the 462-vertex odd graph KG(11,5); no claim for higher odd graphs.
Exact exponent defined as a unique positive root; decimal is illustrative.
Comparison with historical literature is bounded; independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: An off-top harmonic determines sharp Gaussian positivity on the 462-vertex odd graph
